Quarterly Financial Report - Q4 2025
Prepared by the Finance Department
Revenue for Q4 reached $4.2 million, representing a 15% increase over Q3. Operating expenses were $3.1 million, yielding an operating margin of 26.2%.
Key highlights include:
The enterprise segment grew 22% year-over-year, driven by three major contract wins in the healthcare and financial services verticals.
Customer retention rate improved to 94.3%, up from 91.7% in the previous quarter.
R&D investment totaled $890,000, focused on next-generation platform capabilities.
